title: The Voidlands of Entody
description: Journey beneath what is known and enter a new dimension: The Voidlands! Conquer terrifying enemies, loot new structures, and explore.
body:
## Description

There is a land beyond what is known. A land of mystery and enigmas; dangers and rewards; doom and hope: The Voidlands. Equip your monacle, gaze into the abyss, and let it gaze back at you.



## Lore

A long long time ago, before the Voidlands were, it was a giant land called Entody. The Bosses, Players, and Mobs all lived together in peace until the Bosses attacked. The Bosses figured out how to condense iron to mine the walls that separated the nations, starting the War. Throughout the onslaught, millions were killed, and players were banned. However, this was when the final one appeared: Herobrine. He tried to stop the war, but the fruits of his efforts only resulted in destruction and doom. The result of this pestilence was the Voidlands.



## About The Voidlands

_The following quotes may or may not have been misinterpreted. However, as interpretations are part of the New Literature movement, it should be fine. These are expressions of our own whimsy, so please do not get literature on us and somehow find a way to sue us._

"The greatest victory is [somehow walking through Solidified Void unscathed.]" (Sun Tzu, "The Art Of War". 5th Century BC)
"Know thy [biomes], know thy [ways to run away from tnt and hide in a lighthouse while crying like a baby]" (Sun Tzu, "The Art Of War". 5th Century BC.)
"Pacman's a bad guy?" (Adam Sandler, Pixels)
"When thy comes face with an enemy, please do not have an accident and run away." (The Voidlands Developer. 08/13/2025, 16:55)

Some say that herobrine still lurks amongst the void.
